# opnsense_radvd_entry (Data Source)

IPv6 router advertisements (**Services ▸ Router Advertisements**), one entry per interface.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the router advertisement.

### Read-Only

- `base_interface` (String) Interface whose IPv6 prefix is advertised, for tracked interfaces.
- `cur_hop_limit` (Number) Hop limit advertised to clients.
- `default_lifetime` (Number) Router lifetime, in seconds.
- `default_preference` (String) Default router preference.
- `deprecate_prefix` (String) DeprecatePrefix option: `on`, `off`, or empty for the default.
- `dns` (Boolean) Advertise DNS servers and search domains.
- `dnssl` (Set of String) DNS search domains to advertise.
- `dnssl_lifetime` (Number) Lifetime of the advertised search domains, in seconds.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether router advertisements are sent on this interface.
- `interface` (String) Interface to advertise on, e.g. `lan`.
- `link_mtu` (Number) MTU to advertise.
- `max_interval` (Number) Maximum interval between unsolicited advertisements, in seconds.
- `min_interval` (Number) Minimum interval between unsolicited advertisements, in seconds.
- `mode` (String) Advertisement mode: `router` (router only), `unmanaged` (SLAAC), `managed` (DHCPv6), `assist` (SLAAC and DHCPv6), `stateless` (SLAAC and stateless DHCPv6).
- `nat64_prefix` (String) NAT64 prefix to advertise (PREF64).
- `preferred_lifetime` (Number) Preferred lifetime of the prefix, in seconds.
- `rdnss` (Set of String) DNS servers to advertise. Empty advertises the firewall when `dns` is enabled.
- `rdnss_lifetime` (Number) Lifetime of the advertised DNS servers, in seconds.
- `remove_adv_on_exit` (String) RemoveAdvOnExit option: `on`, `off`, or empty for the default.
- `remove_route` (String) RemoveRoute option: `on`, `off`, or empty for the default.
- `route_lifetime` (Number) Lifetime of the advertised routes, in seconds.
- `routes` (Set of String) Additional routes to advertise, in CIDR notation.
- `source_address` (String) Source address of the advertisements.
- `valid_lifetime` (Number) Valid lifetime of the prefix, in seconds.
